script:
Chu Wanhu (Master of Longevity Gate)
Chu Wanhu has been the master of Longevity Gate for 20 years. Twenty years ago, he went to sea alone for business and unfortunately encountered a great storm. After drifting for three days and nights, he came to this island and discovered that it was rich in minerals, thus becoming the most successful mining tycoon. For these 20 years, he has been operating his business on the island. His household includes the chief steward Ma San, who handles household affairs and has some cunning. There's also bodyguard Li Hao, who seems to be close to the steward. His later-married young wife Wang Tingting is young and beautiful. There's also the playboy Chu Chuan, who is his son - Chu Chuan and Wang Tingting are about 7-8 years apart in age. There's also a doctor named Su Shengce. Speaking of him, there's a very strange thing: in recent years, after Chu Wanhu took medicine given by Su Shengce, he couldn't remember many things from before, and his memory became poor. He can remember very few things, and some of what he knows came from others.
In the 50th year of the Sea Calendar, after Chu Wanhu took medicine given by Su Shengce, his memory rapidly deteriorated. Normally, Su Shengce would bring sleeping medicine every night, but since then, Chu Wanhu never drank any medicine from Su Shengce again.
In the 51st year of the Sea Calendar, his prestige in Longevity Gate declined further, and all affairs of Longevity Gate were managed by Wang Tingting.
That same year, Chu Wanhu discovered a forbidden area in the back mountain. Every time he went to the forbidden area, Chu Wanhu would tremble, break into cold sweats, and suffer splitting headaches. The image of a strange woman would appear and disappear in his mind. Based on his memory, he drew a portrait of the woman.
In the 52nd year of the Sea Calendar, Chu Wanhu and Wang Tingting held a criticism meeting because his son Chu Chuan had relations with the maid Tang Yaoyao - what would people think if this got out? Chu Wanhu quietly waited for Wang Tingting to handle it. Wang Tingting was about to have Tang Yaoyao executed when Tang Yaoyao shouted loudly, "Master, save me! I know Madam's secret!" Wang Tingting panicked and immediately had the steward take Tang Yaoyao away to "handle it cleanly," while young master Chu Chuan remained as usual. Later, when Chu Wanhu wanted to ask Wang Tingting what the secret was, Wang Tingting told him, "You don't need to pretend. I know all your secrets. There's no point in your escape." Chu Wanhu remembered that this year he went to see Su Shengce for an illness.
In the 55th year of the Sea Calendar, on September 25th, Chu Wanhu's head became even more dizzy. He couldn't remember clearly what happened the day before and sometimes had hallucinations.
On September 26th, Chu Wanhu had unbearable headaches and his mind went blank - he forgot even what happened a few hours ago.
September 27th: During dinner, Chu Wanhu fainted directly. When he woke up, he saw it was exactly 8 PM, and Wang Tingting was reviewing documents. Seeing Wang Tingting's serious appearance, the passion in Chu Wanhu's heart was ignited, and he pulled Wang Tingting to the bed. But then, this scene flashed through Chu Wanhu's mind: "That strange woman appeared again, smiling at Chu Wanhu. That laughter was so pure but mixed with sadness. Chu Wanhu held a knife, and the dead soul under the knife was laughing. From that laughter, Chu Wanhu felt resentment and shrillness."
Chu Wanhu went mad. His hands that were wandering on Wang Tingting's delicate body grabbed Wang Tingting's neck, choking tighter and tighter. But suddenly Wang Tingting disappeared before his eyes, the bed disappeared too, and only the ground enlarged before his eyes. After falling, Chu Wanhu struggled to get up and saw a figure rush out of the room. Chu Wanhu chased out without thinking. Due to his physical condition, Chu Wanhu couldn't keep up with that person, gradually stopped, and then fainted.
Only Clue: None.
